new_items.title: FDA Approves First-of-Its-Kind Chronic Hepatitis B Treatment
new_items.summary: FDA today approved Hibsago (bepirovirsen) injection, in combination with existing antiviral therapy, to treat chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in certain adults without cirrhosis.
